description: Anthropic (official API) — claude-haiku-4-5 carries the high-traffic standard tier (fast) and explores on flash, claude-sonnet-5 codes on pro and judges on max: the entire opus line (opus-4-5 through opus-5-5 at $4-5/$20-25) and fable-5/5-1 ($10/$50) breach the $3/$15 cost red line, so sonnet-5 is the strongest in-family reviewer under the cap. All Claude models accept images and PDFs — vision uses claude-sonnet-5 for balanced quality. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
